entries.title: The Forest

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed. VR requires compatible PC VR hardware.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation, with headset-dependent VR fidelity.

primary.version: Current PC release with VR support
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original full release, has PC VR support, and is the best fidelity/capture route. The PS4 port is valid but does not add sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Forest on Steam for Windows PC; use the standard PC build for normal capture or its PC VR mode if you want the VR route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with optional VR support.
all_releases.reason: primary: original full-release route, best fidelity/capture path, and VR support.
skip: console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No PS4-exclusive gameplay content is documented; Windows PC has the best fidelity/capture route and VR support.

entries.remaster_caveats: PC VR support is a mode of the PC release rather than a separate game entry. The PS4 version is a port, not a remaster.

entries.title: Sons of the Forest
entries.definitive_edition: Sons of the Forest on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Sons of the Forest released in Early Access and then 1.0 only on Windows PC. No console release is sourced as of the current archive pass, so PC is the only complete playable route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Sons of the Forest on Steam for Windows PC and use the current 1.0+ build.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC full release after Early Access.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced playable release route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate released platform is documented; Windows PC is the only playable route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console versions are not sourced as released as of this pass. Forest 3 has been announced, but without a playable release it is not added as an entry yet.
